messages:
Priya: heads-up — we have a hosted API spike causing 504s for a single tenant. looks like a graceful-window/grace-window-collapse in the continuous-batcher. started at ~11:02 UTC. assigning.
Ajay: confirmed in logs — cbatcher queue_depth climbing toward limit, dequeue stalls, KV misses spike. sample: ```[cbatcher] tenant=acct-42 queue_depth=820/1024 p95_dequeue=1.8s evictions=120 gateway=504 backend_timed_out```
ops-bot: Incident INC-8742 created and paged oncall Ajay.
Evan: customer (acme-pay) reported ~200 5xx responses at 11:03 UTC. they included a small repro payload and a curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" -d '{\"input\":\"<long prompt>\",\"max_tokens\":1024}'`
Carlos: quick check — not auth or billing. token validation OK, billing records normal. spike aligns with longseq requests and heavy kvcache churn.
Priya: repro steps I used in staging: 1) spawn 200 concurrent requests with token-length ~900 2) watch `/metrics` for `cbatcher_queue_depth` and `kvcache_misses` 3) see gateway 504s after queue hits threshold. example command: `kubectl --namespace hosted exec -it deploy/loadgen -- ab -n 200 -c 50 http://hosted-gateway.internal/v1/generate`
Ajay: immediate mitigation applied: enabled `early_reject` for acct-42 at gateway, lowered per-tenant queue_limit 1024->512, and pushed traffic-fallback to smaller model `rwd-small-1` for that tenant. rolling now.
Priya: patch rolled. metrics now: `cbatcher_queue_depth=430`, `p95_dequeue=420ms`, `kvcache_miss_rate` trending down. starting 30m watch.
Evan: updated customer — we implemented a temporary mitigation and are monitoring. they replied: \"Thanks, will validate on our side and report if they see issues.\" :thumbsup:
Carlos: follow-ups (post-mortem/action items): [1] add surge-protection by tenant (adaptive early_reject), [2] expose continuous-batcher backpressure metrics to support console, [3] add KV warmup during heavy seq workloads, [4] create canary load test that mimics kv-miss pattern.
Ajay: opened infra PR rwd/infra#2345 to add config flags + runbook note. runbook snippet: \"if grace-window collapse observed -> enable early_reject, reduce queue_limit, increase dequeue_concurrency, or route to dedicated pool.\"
Priya: plan: keep mitigation for 1h, if stable remove early_reject and then apply autoscale tweaks. if recurrence within 24h escalate to dedicated assignment.
ops-bot: Alert for tenant acct-42 cleared at 1759429390.
Evan: closing customer-facing ticket after 1h stable unless they reopen.
Priya: leaving thread open for 45m to validate metrics, will update and archive.
Carlos: noted — we'll include load-test in next sprint and add a short KB for support to explain early_reject behavior.
